summary: CustomReports manages the creation, update, search, completion, and file handling for custom report requests within HSPnet. It tracks the lifecycle, metadata, parameters, and associated files for each report, integrates email notifications, and enforces business rules for request handling and status transitions.
purpose: To track and manage custom report requests, their parameters, associated files, and processing status, supporting workflows for creation, update, completion, cancellation, refusal, and fulfillment by administrators and users.

workflows.name: Create Custom Report
steps: User fills out request details including purpose, audience, parameters.
Report is added via CustomReports.Add or CustomReportAdd stored procedure.
Parameters are stored, report status initialized.
Email notification sent to support staff.

workflows.name: Update Custom Report
steps: User or admin updates report fields and parameters.
Old parameters are deleted, new parameters added.
Database update operations performed, email notification sent if successful.

workflows.name: Attach/Update File to Custom Report
steps: File uploaded and associated metadata stored.
Old file and folder deleted (if exists).
Database updated with new file info.
Email notification sent to requesting user (on success/failure).

workflows.name: Search Custom Reports
steps: Reports filtered by agency, department, user, status, date interval, and sort expression.
Multiple date-range types supported (Today, CurrentTerm, PastTerm, PastYear, PreviousYears).

workflows.name: Manage Request Lifecycle
steps: ReturnToUser: Admin processes and returns report.
RefuseRequest: Sysadmin refuses report (distinct from cancellation).
CompleteRequest: Sysadmin marks request as completed (may not involve file upload).

business_rules: Requests may be cancelled by user or refused by sysadmin.
Completion may occur without file upload (for non-HSPnet users).
Parameter values must be stored and displayed accurately.
File upload and update must validate non-empty file paths and URLs.
validations: FileURL and FilePath must not be blank during upload/update.
Valid UUID formats for document queries and associations.
Date fields are validated for expected range or nullability.
Proper masking for phone fields depending on language and agency.
calculations: File size presented in kilobytes (display logic).
Date ranges calculated for filtering reports: Today, CurrentTerm, PastTerm, PastYear, PreviousYears.
conditions: If created == 'Today', use today's date for filtering.
If created == 'CurrentTerm', set range by fiscal term.
If created == 'PastTerm', calculate prior term dates.
If created == 'PastYear', range is previous year.
If created == 'PreviousYears', range is all previous years up to fiscal year end.
system_behavior: Automatic sending of email notifications on report creation, update, and file upload.
Handling of file deletion and directory management on file updates.
Procedure-driven operations for searching, updating, completing, cancelling, refusing requests.
Localization for file type and status fields based on session and language.
dependencies: Database procedures: CustomReportAdd, CustomReportUpdate, CustomReportCancelRequest, CustomReportRefuseRequest, CustomReportReturnToUser, CustomReportSearch, CustomReportUpdateFile, CustomReportSearchByID
Email templates: CustomReportUploadedSubject, CustomReportUploadedBody, CustomReportSubmittedSubject, CustomReportSubmittedBody
UI date formatting and localization utilities
exceptions: File deletion and directory removal during file update may fail silently.
Email may not be sent; errors surfaced to user.
Filename extraction from file path may fail and is handled gracefully.
